# momputer

> momputer is a Windows widget that turns off what AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex and others) left running, frees up disk space, checks drives, memory, sound and Windows settings, and tidies folders. She always shows you first. Free for personal use on Windows 10 and 11.

## Get it
- [Download for Windows](https://github.com/Thisisily/momputer/releases/latest): the file ending in -setup.exe. Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit.
- [Install steps](https://thisisily.github.io/momputer/#install): three steps, about a minute. momputer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows may show "Windows protected your PC": More info, then Run anyway.

## What it does
- Running: everything agents started (dev servers, watchers, headless browsers), which agent started it, and one button to stop what was left behind.
- Upkeep: what can be deleted, and exactly what it is, before anything goes.
- Checkup: drives, memory, graphics, sound, updates and Windows settings, with a fix for each problem.
- Rooms: grades a messy folder and tidies it, with undo.
- House rules: one set of rules every agent is given, and checked against.
- A `mom` command for the terminal, and check-in hooks for Claude Code and Codex.

## Skills
- [momputer-skills](https://github.com/Thisisily/momputer/tree/main/skills): eleven skills for Claude Code and Codex, each tidying one room of your digital life. They work without momputer, under the Apache License 2.0, free for any use.

## Promises
- Shows what goes and what stays before any clean-up; your own files go to the Recycle Bin.
- Sends nothing about you or your PC. The one request it makes is a daily check with GitHub for a newer version, which a switch in Settings turns off.
